messages:
elyse: Heads-up — noticed a gap in the console migration where latency percentiles render with the wrong bucket labels after the YAML->UI import. p50/p95 look fine but p99 reads like it's in ms when the data is seconds. Can someone sanity-check?

sam: ugh, thanks for catching. This is the YAML snippet we ship in the docs by default: the buckets were written as seconds in the example but the dashboard expects milliseconds. so the UI divides differently.

jordan: that explains the weird spike alignment I saw in the heatmap preview. also worth noting: if trace sampling is enabled upstream you can get skewed p99s (fewer long tails sampled). we should add a note.

maria: quick checklist: 1) fix example buckets to ms 2) add a short callout about sampling + percentiles 3) add a small test dataset or screenshot so reviewers can validate import.

elyse: plan: I'll open a docs PR that updates the YAML snippet, adds a callout, and a minimal import preview screenshot. tagging reviewers @sam @jordan.

sam: sounds good. please include this corrected example in the snippet block so users can copy-paste: 

```yaml
# latency histogram buckets for console heatmap (milliseconds)
latency_histogram_buckets: [1,5,10,25,50,75,100,250,500,1000,2500,5000]
# note: previous examples were in seconds which breaks the UI import
```

jordan: also add a one-liner about trace sampling: "If you apply an upstream trace sampling policy, p99/p999 percentiles may appear artificially low — consider sampling-aware rollups or augmenting with aggregated logs."

elyse: good wording. I'll add it as a gray callout in the migration guide and inline in the snippet.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs PR checklist — include `screenshots/` artifacts, add cross-links to "trace sampling" page, run `make docs-preview`.

maria: for the screenshot, we should show both before/after labels (seconds vs ms) so reviewers can see the impact. low-effort: take the exported yaml and reimport to a staging console.

elyse: I'll capture a 2-panel screenshot. also adding a tiny validation script in the PR description so maintainers can run locally: 

```bash
# validate buckets are plausible (ms)
python - <<'PY'
vals = [1,5,10,25,50,75,100,250,500,1000,2500,5000]
assert all(v>0 and v<60000 for v in vals), 'bucket out of range'
print('ok')
PY
```

sam: perfect. one nit: call out units explicitly in the YAML comment so users don't miss it.

elyse: done. PR drafted: #7432. adding reviewers and the screenshot. will ping infra to run a staging import.

deploy-bot: staged import available at https://staging.console.internal/imports/7432-preview — runs every 10m.

maria: I'll spot-check the import later today and leave a quick QA note. if all good, merge after a weekday window. :thumbsup:

elyse: thanks all — target merge tomorrow EOD if nothing blocks. I'll post the PR link here once created.

sam: thanks, nice catch! :raised_hands:
